title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Tunnel Close Echo Work Item
summary: Add server-side tunnel context helpers that let WebSocket handlers read messages, write unmasked server frames, and echo a received close frame before orderly write completion.
planned_changes:
- Add stateful message reading to `Http3WebSocketTunnelContext` using the existing server-side WebSocket parser.
- Add a context write helper that formats unmasked server-to-client WebSocket frames.
- Add a close echo helper that validates a received close frame, writes the echoed close frame, and completes the writable side with FIN.
- Add a loopback HTTP/3 server test that sends a masked client close frame, observes an unmasked echoed close frame, and observes stream EOF.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket close echo test, the existing handler-dispatch regression, the RFC 9220 WebSocket parser tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: The accepted tunnel context now has a locally verified close echo path that reuses the parser and writer surfaces and completes the stream with an orderly FIN.
